REPLACE VIEW MART.V_SALES_SUMMARY AS
LOCKING ROW FOR ACCESS
SEL  c.CAL_DATE
   , s.REGION
   , SUM(f.ORDER_AMT) (FORMAT 'ZZZ,ZZZ,ZZ9.99') AS REVENUE
   , COUNT(*) AS ORDERS
FROM CORE.ORDER_FACT f
JOIN CORE.CALENDAR_DIM c ON c.CAL_DATE = f.ORDER_DATE
JOIN CORE.STORE_DIM s ON s.STORE_ID = f.STORE_ID
WHERE f.ORDER_DATE >= ADD_MONTHS(CURRENT_DATE, -24)
GROUP BY 1, 2;

REPLACE VIEW MART.V_TOP_CUSTOMERS AS
SEL TOP 100 c.CUST_ID, c.CUST_NAME, SUM(f.ORDER_AMT) AS REVENUE
FROM CORE.ORDER_FACT f
JOIN CORE.CUSTOMER_DIM c ON c.CUSTOMER_KEY = f.CUSTOMER_KEY
WHERE c.IS_CURRENT = 1
GROUP BY 1, 2
QUALIFY RANK() OVER (ORDER BY REVENUE DESC) <= 100;

REPLACE VIEW MART.V_CUST_SEGMENT AS
SEL c.CUST_ID
  , c.SEGMENT
  , ZEROIFNULL(x.LIFETIME_VALUE) AS LTV
  , CASE WHEN x.LAST_ORDER_DT > CURRENT_DATE - 90 THEN 'ACTIVE' ELSE 'LAPSED' END AS STATUS
  , BEGIN(c.VALID_PERIOD) AS VALID_FROM
  , OREPLACE(c.CUST_NAME, '  ', ' ') AS CLEAN_NAME
  , INDEX(c.CUST_NAME, 'LTD') AS LTD_POS
FROM CORE.CUSTOMER_DIM c
LEFT JOIN MART.CUSTOMER_360 x ON x.CUST_ID = c.CUST_ID
WHERE c.VALID_PERIOD CONTAINS CURRENT_DATE;

REPLACE VIEW CORE.V_ACTIVE_PRODUCTS AS
SEL PRODUCT_KEY, PROD_ID, PROD_NAME, CATEGORY
FROM CORE.PRODUCT_DIM
WHERE CATEGORY IS NOT NULL;

REPLACE PROCEDURE ETL.SP_ARCHIVE_2018 ()
BEGIN
  INSERT INTO MART.REGION_PERF_2019
  SEL s.REGION, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM f.ORDER_DATE) * 100 + EXTRACT(MONTH FROM f.ORDER_DATE), SUM(f.ORDER_AMT)
  FROM CORE.ORDER_FACT f JOIN CORE.STORE_DIM s ON s.STORE_ID = f.STORE_ID
  WHERE f.ORDER_DATE BETWEEN DATE '2018-01-01' AND DATE '2018-12-31'
  GROUP BY 1, 2;
END;

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW GL.V_ACCOUNT_HIERARCHY AS
SELECT ACCOUNT_ID,
       ACCOUNT_CODE,
       LPAD(' ', 2 * (LEVEL - 1)) || ACCOUNT_NAME AS ACCOUNT_TREE,
       LEVEL AS DEPTH,
       SYS_CONNECT_BY_PATH(ACCOUNT_CODE, '/') AS PATH,
       CONNECT_BY_ISLEAF AS IS_LEAF
FROM GL.GL_ACCOUNTS
START WITH PARENT_ACCOUNT_ID IS NULL
CONNECT BY PRIOR ACCOUNT_ID = PARENT_ACCOUNT_ID
ORDER SIBLINGS BY ACCOUNT_CODE;

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW GL.V_TRIAL_BALANCE AS
SELECT p.PERIOD_NAME,
       a.ACCOUNT_CODE,
       a.ACCOUNT_NAME,
       DECODE(a.ACCOUNT_TYPE, 'A', 'Asset', 'L', 'Liability', 'E', 'Expense', 'R', 'Revenue', 'Other') AS ACCOUNT_CLASS,
       SUM(NVL(l.ENTERED_DR, 0)) AS TOTAL_DR,
       SUM(NVL(l.ENTERED_CR, 0)) AS TOTAL_CR,
       NVL2(MAX(l.JE_LINE_ID), 'HAS_ACTIVITY', 'NO_ACTIVITY') AS ACTIVITY_FLAG,
       TO_CHAR(p.END_DATE, 'DD-MON-YYYY') AS PERIOD_END
FROM GL.GL_PERIODS p, GL.GL_ACCOUNTS a, GL.GL_JOURNAL_LINES l
WHERE l.PERIOD_NAME (+) = p.PERIOD_NAME
  AND l.ACCOUNT_ID (+) = a.ACCOUNT_ID
  AND p.STATUS = 'O'
GROUP BY p.PERIOD_NAME, a.ACCOUNT_CODE, a.ACCOUNT_NAME, a.ACCOUNT_TYPE, p.END_DATE;

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW AP.V_AP_AGING AS
SELECT * FROM (
  SELECT s.SUPPLIER_NAME,
         i.INVOICE_NUM,
         i.INVOICE_AMOUNT,
         TRUNC(SYSDATE) - TRUNC(i.INVOICE_DATE) AS DAYS_OPEN,
         CASE WHEN TRUNC(SYSDATE) - i.INVOICE_DATE > 90 THEN '90+'
              WHEN TRUNC(SYSDATE) - i.INVOICE_DATE > 60 THEN '61-90'
              WHEN TRUNC(SYSDATE) - i.INVOICE_DATE > 30 THEN '31-60'
              ELSE '0-30' END AS BUCKET
  FROM AP.AP_INVOICES i, AP.AP_SUPPLIERS s
  WHERE i.SUPPLIER_ID = s.SUPPLIER_ID
  ORDER BY i.INVOICE_AMOUNT DESC
) WHERE ROWNUM <= 5000;

CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE HR.PRC_ORG_CHART AS
BEGIN
  DELETE FROM HR.ORG_CHART_FLAT;
  INSERT INTO HR.ORG_CHART_FLAT (EMPLOYEE_ID, FULL_NAME, MGR_PATH, ORG_LEVEL, DEPARTMENT_NAME)
  SELECT e.EMPLOYEE_ID,
         e.FULL_NAME,
         SYS_CONNECT_BY_PATH(e.FULL_NAME, ' > '),
         LEVEL,
         d.DEPARTMENT_NAME
  FROM HR.EMPLOYEES e, HR.DEPARTMENTS d
  WHERE e.DEPARTMENT_ID = d.DEPARTMENT_ID (+)
  START WITH e.MANAGER_ID IS NULL
  CONNECT BY NOCYCLE PRIOR e.EMPLOYEE_ID = e.MANAGER_ID;
  COMMIT;
END;

CREATE OR REPLACE TRIGGER HR.TRG_EMP_AUDIT
AFTER INSERT OR UPDATE OR DELETE ON HR.EMPLOYEES
FOR EACH ROW
BEGIN
  INSERT INTO HR.EMPLOYEES_AUDIT (EMPLOYEE_ID, ACTION, CHANGED_BY, CHANGED_AT, OLD_MANAGER, NEW_MANAGER)
  VALUES (NVL(:NEW.EMPLOYEE_ID, :OLD.EMPLOYEE_ID),
          CASE WHEN INSERTING THEN 'I' WHEN UPDATING THEN 'U' ELSE 'D' END,
          SYS_CONTEXT('USERENV', 'SESSION_USER'), SYSTIMESTAMP, :OLD.MANAGER_ID, :NEW.MANAGER_ID);
END;
